Game Overview

At its heart, Zombies Stay Alive is a action game about become an ultimate zombie slayer in a thrilling Minecraft-inspired world. Outlast the relentless undead horde by seeking and upgrading weapons, navigating with precision, and outshining your rivals. Engage in heart-pounding action where survival means constant motion, strategic exploration, and ever-increasing firepower. Will you emerge as the hero?

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Zombies Stay Alive is easy to pick up. Become an ultimate zombie slayer in a thrilling Minecraft-inspired world.
